# SpamBrain

*Product*

Google's AI-based spam-prevention system.

**Glossary** (*SpamBrain*): Google's AI-based spam prevention system, launched in 2018 and continuously improved since; Google said it is now built on Gemini.

Narrative: the topic [Spam detection and SpamBrain](../topics/spam-detection.md) tells the story; this card lists what links to it.

9 claims mention it: 3 from Google's documentation, 4 shown or said at the event (2 not in Google docs, 2 confirmed by Google docs), 2 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [A guide to Google Search ranking systems](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ranking-systems-guide), [How we fought spam on Google Search in 2022](https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2023/04/webspam-report-2022).

- [`D2-C671`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Docs: Google's 2021 webspam report says SpamBrain, its AI-based spam-prevention system, was launched in 2018 and has been continuously improved since. `[D2-C671, docs, Search Central blog (21 April 2022), https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2022/04/webspam-report-2021]`
- [`D2-C674`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Docs: Google's 2022 webspam report says SpamBrain detected 5 times more spam sites in 2022 than in 2021, and 200 times more than when it first launched. `[D2-C674, docs, Search Central blog (11 April 2023), https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2023/04/webspam-report-2022]`
- [`D3-C287`](../sessions/D3-S07-what-are-quality-updates.md) Docs: Google's spam updates page says its automated spam detection systems run constantly, and a notable improvement to them, such as to the AI-based SpamBrain system, is called a spam update and listed with Google's ranking updates. `[D3-C287, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/updates/spam-updates]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D2-C669`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: SpamBrain, Google's AI-based spam detection system, is nowadays built on Gemini and fine-tuned specifically for finding spam. `[D2-C669, stage, Google, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C673`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: SpamBrain was said to detect 5 times more spam sites than the spam algorithms Google had launched before it. `[D2-C673, stage, Google, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C670`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Stage, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: SpamBrain is central to Google's spam-fighting efforts and has been improved many times since its launch. `[D2-C670, stage, Google, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C676`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Stage, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: Google's testing shows that, thanks to SpamBrain, more than 99% of visits from Search are now spam-free. `[D2-C676, stage, Google, Day 2]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D2-C672`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Analysis: The SpamBrain launch year mentioned on stage, with hesitation, was 2022, which does not match Google's documented 2018; 2022 is the year of the improvements described in Google's 2022 webspam report, so cite 2018 as the launch year. `[D2-C672, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D2-C675`](../sessions/D2-S19-calculating-some-signals.md) Analysis: The '5 times more spam sites' figure said on stage matches Google's 2022 webspam report, but the report compares 2022 with 2021 (and gives 200 times since launch), not SpamBrain with earlier algorithms; quote the documented comparison. `[D2-C675, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
